fields.title: Dungeon Features
fields.first_impression: A pitch-black dungeon of rough-hewn stone.

fields.title: 1 BOWLS
fields.first_impression: Three enormous stone bowls occupy the pitch-black room; each bowl contains bound human captives.
contents: Each bowl contains 4 human sacrifices, bound hand and foot.
occupants: 12 human sacrifices, bound hand and foot.
triggers: The game begins here with the Lamb lumbering into the room.

fields.title: 1A FIRST INTERSECTION
fields.first_impression: A barnyard smell comes from the east.

fields.title: 1B SECOND INTERSECTION
fields.first_impression: A barnyard smell comes from the north, faint light comes from the east, and a vinegar smell comes from the south.

fields.title: 1C THIRD INTERSECTION
fields.first_impression: A vinegar smell comes from the west.

fields.title: 2 GOATS
fields.first_impression: Three dead goats and one live, dehydrated goat are tied with short twine; all wear bells. A hay pile and an empty wooden bowl are nearby.
contents: One live goat, dehydrated and friendly.
Short lengths of twine tying the goats.
Bells worn by all four goats.

fields.title: 3 VINEGAR
fields.first_impression: One stone trough is half-filled with reeking vinegar; another empty trough smells of stale milk.
contents: Empty stone trough that stinks of stale milk.

discoverable.information: An empty wine bottle is in the vinegar trough.

fields.title: 4 CHESTS
fields.first_impression: A locked wooden door protects a room containing a wooden table, a wooden chest, and a lead-and-iron chest chained to the floor.
contents: Lead-and-iron chest bolted to the floor and bound with two linchpinned chains.

discoverable.information: The wooden chest contains a masterwork helmet, 1 torch, 2 doses of purple lotus powder, and a lotus pipe.
The lead-and-iron chest contains only the Skull of Davok.
discoverable.condition: Remove both linchpins and open the lead-and-iron chest.

hazards: Removing the first linchpin causes headaches.
Removing the second linchpin causes nosebleeds.
triggers: Opening the lead-and-iron chest allows the Skull of Davok to escape.

fields.title: 5 LANDING
fields.first_impression: Heavy steel doors are locked from the far side, with ascending stairs barely visible behind them. A lit torch stands to the left; a sturdy table and locked iron-banded chest stand to the right. A horrible stench comes from the east.
contents: Heavy steel doors locked from the other side.
Ascending stairs barely visible behind the doors.
Lit torch atop a metal pole.

discoverable.information: The chest contains a fresh torch and a vial of lamp oil.

resources: Lit torch with about 1 hour of burn time remaining.
hazards: Methods forceful enough to open the chest break the vial of lamp oil.

fields.title: 5A CLOSET
fields.first_impression: A small closet contains a broom, a gong, and a hammer.

fields.title: 6 TUMBLERS
fields.first_impression: A fish-with-hands statue holds four numbered rotating disks. A recessed doorway on the far wall cannot be forced open; a wall lever and a tiny pool of milky liquid are nearby.
contents: Statue of a fish with hands.
Four rotating disks, each showing a number from 1 to 8.
Recessed doorway impossible to force open.

discoverable.information: A quartet of small acid nozzles is set in the ceiling.

hidden: The room is a password-entry system.
hazards: An incorrect entry produces a horrible grinding noise every time and sprays milky acid once.
triggers: Pulling the lever checks the four-digit tumbler setting.

fields.title: 7 THRONE
fields.first_impression: A throne of sheep bones and unfired clay stands beside a golden sensory-deprivation helmet.
contents: Throne of sheep bones and unfired clay.
hidden: The throne works only once per year.
Anyone with a lobster claw is Favored by Vandoh.
Sitting on the throne is a Milestone.
triggers: Sitting on the throne requires a Charisma Save and causes a transformation and vision.

fields.title: 8 PIT
fields.first_impression: A slimy pit, 40 feet deep and 30 feet across, has smooth stone walls, knee-deep mud at the bottom, and a strong ammonia-and-feces smell.
contents: Slimy pit 40 feet deep and 30 feet across.
hidden: This is where the Lamb sleeps.
Akina cleans the Lamb of parasites and eats its vomit.
hazards: The pit is impossible to climb.
occupants: The Lamb is present 0% of the time on the first visit and 2-in-6 on subsequent visits.

fields.title: 9 FOUNTAIN
fields.first_impression: A 30-foot-deep slimy pool surrounds a dripping fountain shaped like a fish with hands. Its water falls in the regular rhythm “drip . . . drip drip . . . drip . . . drip drip.”
contents: Dripping fountain shaped like a fish with hands.

discoverable.information: An armored skeleton lies in the shallows.

hidden: The first person to touch the water is supernaturally shoved in and held beneath the surface.
hazards: The first entrant hallucinates drowning for 1 round.
The first person to touch the water is pulled in with no save and cannot bring any body part out of the water.
occupants: The Lamb is present 100% of the time on the first visit and 2-in-6 on subsequent visits.

fields.title: 9A UNDERWATER TUNNEL
fields.first_impression: An underwater tunnel leads away from the fountain pool.
contents: A person can swim the tunnel in 5 minutes.

fields.title: 10 BONE PILE
fields.first_impression: A pile contains 255 bone pellets, each holding about 100 pounds of compressed bone fragments only slightly smoothed by digestion.

discoverable.information: A small crawl tunnel leads to 14 SARCOPHAGUS.
discoverable.condition: Spend any amount of time searching the pile.

hidden: After 3 encounters with the Lamb, it becomes cunning and begins blocking the crawl tunnel with bones.
resources: One d20 search result per man-hour, using the Bone Pile Search table.
triggers: After 3 encounters with the Lamb, the Lamb begins blocking the crawl tunnel.

fields.title: 11 CRAB MURAL
fields.first_impression: A mural shows a crab being groomed in a woman’s lap. A friendly rat is present, and a wooden door to the east is locked.
contents: Locked wooden door to the east.

fields.title: 12 ABACUS MURAL
fields.first_impression: A mural shows an impossible abacus with Vandoh, a polygon-headed man, calculating inside it. The sagging roof is held up by a 10-foot wooden pike.
contents: Image of Vandoh performing a calculation.
10-foot wooden pike supporting the sagging roof.
hazards: Removing the pike collapses the ceiling; a person grabbing it and running must pass a Movement check to avoid dying.
triggers: Removing the supporting pike causes the ceiling to collapse and makes the room impassable.

fields.title: 13 CITY MURAL
fields.first_impression: A mural depicts a city under the waves. A huge spiderweb-filled crack runs along the south wall with a faint breeze coming through it; a moldy, badly damaged locked door blocks the east passage.
contents: Mural of a city under the waves.
Huge spiderweb-filled crack along the south wall.
Moldy, locked, badly damaged eastern door.

discoverable.information: The damaged eastern door can be quietly wrenched off its hinges.
discoverable.condition: Examine or try to manipulate the badly damaged door.

hidden: The Lamb previously damaged the eastern door by ramming it in a fit of madness.

fields.title: 14 SARCOPHAGUS
fields.first_impression: An unused wall torch hangs beside an obvious northward crawl tunnel and an empty sarcophagus inscribed “Shadrakul, who will not meet her apprentice in this life.” The lid edges are bladed.
contents: Obvious crawl tunnel north to 10 BONE PILE.
Inscription: “Shadrakul, who will not meet her apprentice in this life.”

discoverable.information: A seam runs along the middle of the sarcophagus bottom.
discoverable.condition: Clear dust from the empty sarcophagus.

discoverable.information: The bottom is metal and sounds hollow.
discoverable.condition: Clear dust and inspect or tap the sarcophagus bottom.

hidden: Replacing the lid over an occupant opens the sarcophagus bottom and dumps the occupant into 14A SHADRAKUL.
Removing the lid again closes the bottom.
hazards: The bladed lid edges are sharp enough to cut ropes and sever ropes when the trap operates.
triggers: Lifting or replacing the lid produces mechanical sounds from below.
Replacing the lid while someone is inside activates the trapdoor.

fields.title: 14A SHADRAKUL
fields.first_impression: A 10-foot drop lands on eight soft rugs; a robed skeleton sits against the wall holding a black iron spellbook and a precariously balanced crystal goblet.
hidden: Once the black iron spellbook is held, the trapdoor locks in the open position.
A skeletal serpent is concealed with the skeleton.
hazards: The slightest touch causes the crystal goblet to tumble and break.
Approaching the skeleton triggers a skeletal serpent attack.

fields.title: 15 CRACK
fields.first_impression: A very tight crack swarms with hundreds of tiny red spiders. A voice arguing about chicken quality can be heard, and daylight is visible at the far end.
contents: Fist-sized opening overlooking the plaza beside the White Temple.
hazards: Each minute of exposure has a 50% chance of a spider bite.
A first bite causes wheezing and muteness for 1 hour; a second bite causes instant death with no Save.
occupants: Danjo, a chicken vendor, sits outside the far opening.

fields.title: 16 MOLD
fields.first_impression: A moldy shape in the center of the room resembles a curled corpse hidden beneath thick fungus.
contents: A corpse-shaped mass covered in thick mold.
hidden: The shape is only mold, not a corpse.

fields.title: 17 ALTAR
fields.first_impression: A yellow-rotted wooden chest stands near an altar holding a sheep skull amid faded flowers.
contents: Rotten, worthless books inside the chest.
Silver-plate dageurrotype worth 50s inside the chest.
Altar with a sheep skull and faded flowers.

discoverable.information: A concealed drawer in the altar contains one white candle.

hazards: Carelessly opening the chest exposes the opener to yellow mold poison for 1d6 damage.
triggers: Carelessly opening the chest triggers yellow mold exposure.

fields.title: 18 SHAFT
fields.first_impression: A 7-foot-high heap of broken beams and bricks, apparently a shattered gazebo but actually a fallen elevator, sits amid loops of soft rotten rope. A shaft rises 60 feet, with a visible ledge 40 feet up.

discoverable.information: A block and tackle is hidden in the wreckage.

fields.title: 18A LEDGE
fields.first_impression: A 30-foot rope and an iron spike lie before a sealed portcullis. Ten feet beyond the bars is an armored corpse.
contents: Armored corpse 10 feet beyond the portcullis.
resources: The corpse can be pulled to the portcullis and looted for a sword, bow and arrows, signet ring, Orb of Indulgence, masterwork breastplate, and helmet.
hazards: The masterwork breastplate and helmet are too large to pass through the portcullis.

fields.title: The Lamb
fields.appearance: A gigantic, hairless, obese cow-like creature with no obvious head; its neck ends in a drooping cowl of wrinkled flesh, from which it can extend a bloody horse-skull head with sunken eyes and a black tongue. It weighs about 2500 lbs, drags its belly, and reeks of blood and ammonia.
fields.role: The dungeon’s central predator, guarding and roaming between its pit and fountain.
behavior: Mostly remains in 8 PIT and 9 FOUNTAIN.
Its sight and hearing are slightly worse than an average human’s.
It is not smart but is clever, learns from mistakes, and adopts better tactics with exposure.
If it finishes eating or loses track of the party, it heads to 9 FOUNTAIN for a bath.
capabilities: Lvl 6; Def chain; Bite/Crush 1d8/1d18; Move slow; Climb slug; Str 9; Int 3; Dis hungry.
Torches and lanterns make it hesitate, but only a large fire scares it away.
If people try to run past it in a hallway or room, it makes both attacks.
Can climb out of 8 PIT in 2 rounds.
Carries 52 Nascent Lambfruit and 6 Immature Lambfruit.

reactions.response: It calls “Father! Father!” in increasingly loud tones; it can say nothing else.

reactions.stimulus: People hide from it during the opening encounter.
reactions.response: It devours one restrained human at random over 10 minutes and is not very alert while eating.

reactions.stimulus: People flee noisily during the opening encounter.
People leave slowly and quietly during the opening encounter.
It has experienced 3 encounters with the party near 10 BONE PILE.
reactions.response: It becomes cunning and begins blocking the crawl tunnel with bones.

starting_state: Lumbering into 1 BOWLS as the game begins.

fields.title: The Little Lambs
fields.role: Three offspring that emerge from the Lamb’s corpse and hunt as ceiling-climbing predators.
behavior: If the Lamb is killed but its corpse is not utterly destroyed, they wait quietly and then chew out of the corpse.
They will not swim out to the cistern.
They have a 2-in-6 chance to ambush from the ceiling and grapple only during the surprise round.
capabilities: Lvl 2; Def chain; Bite 1d8; Move human; Climb as slug; Str 5; Int 3; Dis hungry.
Will not approach within 10 feet of burning oil because of bright light and fire.

reactions.stimulus: Bright light, fire, or burning oil is nearby.
reactions.response: They avoid approaching within 10 feet of burning oil.

fields.title: Father Bastoval
fields.role: The Lamb’s father and a Nemesis who enters the dungeon with two elderly bodyguards after the Lamb is killed.
behavior: Two hours after the Lamb is killed, he enters the dungeon with his bodyguards to check on it.
If the Lamb is dead, he hunts the Lamb’s murderers.
capabilities: Lvl 3; Def chain; Warfork 1d8; Dis wrathful.
As a Nemesis, each time he kills a PC he gains a level and is thereafter introduced as “Bastoval, Slayer of X”.

fields.title: Mino
fields.role: One of Father Bastoval’s elderly bodyguards.
capabilities: Carries a bow that deals 1d6 damage.

relationships.relationship: Bodyguard serving and accompanying Father Bastoval.
The other member of the elderly bodyguard pair.

uncertainties.description: The heading reads “Milo/Bilosh,” while the equipment sentence says “Mino has a bow.” This record uses Mino from the equipment sentence.

fields.title: Bilosh
fields.role: One of Father Bastoval’s elderly bodyguards.

relationships.relationship: Bodyguard serving and accompanying Father Bastoval.
The other member of the elderly bodyguard pair.

fields.title: Live Goat
fields.appearance: A live goat tied with short twine and wearing a bell.
fields.role: A friendly, dehydrated animal in 2 GOATS.
starting_state: Dehydrated and tied with short twine.

fields.title: Akina
fields.appearance: A woman in rags living at the bottom of the pit.
fields.role: A sane, desperate, intelligent captive who bargains for rescue and can explain the local cult and monster.
behavior: Offers the Ruby Ring of Wisdom in exchange for rescue.
Cleans parasites from the Lamb and eats its vomit.
capabilities: Carries the Ruby Ring of Wisdom, worth 1000s.
Can tell the basics about the White Temple, Vandoh, and the Lamb.
starting_state: Living in 8 PIT; sane, desperate, intelligent, and wearing rags.

fields.title: Friendly Rat
fields.role: A friendly rat encountered in 11 CRAB MURAL.

fields.title: Robed Skeleton
fields.appearance: A robed skeleton seated against the wall, holding out a black iron spellbook and balancing a crystal goblet on its knee.
fields.role: A dead figure in 14A SHADRAKUL that presents the spellbook and anchors a serpent-and-goblet trap.
behavior: Clutches a delicate crystal goblet close to its body.

fields.title: Skeletal Serpent
fields.role: A concealed guardian that lunges from the robed skeleton when anyone approaches.
behavior: Lunges out and attacks anyone who approaches the skeleton.
capabilities: Lvl 1; Def chain; Bite: save or die; Dis guardian.

fields.title: Danjo
fields.appearance: A chicken vendor seated in the plaza beside the White Temple, visible through the fist-sized opening at the end of 15 CRACK.
fields.role: An extortionate outside contact and merchant who can sell or fetch mundane goods.
goals: Extract as much payment or leverage as possible from the party.
behavior: Threatens to tell the temple guards unless given a reason not to.
After the extortion issue is handled, sells mundane items at the highest price he can obtain, never below 20 times market value.
Will run across town to purchase requested goods, taking 1-3 hours depending on the item.

reactions.stimulus: The party first contacts him through the crack.
reactions.response: He extorts them by threatening to inform the temple guards.

fields.title: The Lamb Approaches
fields.perceived: The Lamb approaches, full of bile and loathing.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Alive active encounter table (1-6).

outcomes: The Lamb approaches, full of bile and loathing.

fields.title: The Lamb Is Nearby
fields.perceived: Disgusting, noisy activity is heard from an adjacent room: regurgitating a bone pellet, banging its head against a wall in self-loathing, or dragging its genitals across the ground.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Alive passive encounter table (1-6).

outcomes: Disgusting, noisy activity is heard from an adjacent room: regurgitating a bone pellet, banging its head against a wall in self-loathing, or dragging its genitals across the ground.

fields.title: Distant Grunting and Gnawing
fields.perceived: Distant grunting and gnawing can be heard.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Alive indirect encounter table (1-6).

outcomes: Distant grunting and gnawing can be heard.

fields.title: Three Little Lambs on the Ceiling
fields.perceived: Three Little Lambs crawl on the ceiling, then drop down to run faster.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Dead active encounter table (1-3).

outcomes: Three Little Lambs crawl on the ceiling, then drop down to run faster.

fields.title: Bastoval Checks on the Lamb
fields.perceived: Father Bastoval leads Mino and Bilosh through the dungeon to check on the Lamb.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Dead active encounter table (4-6).

outcomes: Father Bastoval leads Mino and Bilosh through the dungeon to check on the Lamb.

fields.title: Little Lambs Digging Nearby
fields.perceived: The Three Little Lambs can be heard digging loudly inside a nearby wall.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Dead passive encounter table (1-3).

outcomes: The Three Little Lambs can be heard digging loudly inside a nearby wall.

fields.title: Bastoval’s Ghostly Warning
fields.perceived: A ghostly image of Bastoval appears and says, “So that’s where you are.”

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Dead passive encounter table (4-6).

outcomes: Father Bastoval arrives in 1d6 rounds.

fields.title: Echoes of the Lamb
fields.perceived: Faraway echoes of the Lamb’s voice continue crying “Father! Father!”

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Dead indirect encounter table (1-3).

outcomes: Faraway echoes of the Lamb’s voice continue crying “Father! Father!”

fields.title: More Tremors
fields.perceived: More tremors are felt.

activation.condition: Selected on the Lamb Dead indirect encounter table (4-6).

outcomes: More tremors are felt.

fields.title: The Lamb Enters 1 BOWLS
fields.perceived: In pitch darkness, the Lamb is lumbering into the room.

activation.condition: The game begins in 1 BOWLS.

participants.role: Immediate predator entering the starting room.

stakes: A restrained human may be devoured.
Noisy flight can provoke an attack.
The free characters begin dehydrated, naked, and poorly equipped.
outcomes: If the PCs hide, the Lamb devours one restrained human at random over 10 minutes and is not very alert during that time.
If the PCs flee noisily, the Lamb attacks; finding the door in the dark requires a Wisdom check.
If the PCs leave slowly and quietly, they are not noticed.
After eating or losing track of the party, the Lamb goes to 9 FOUNTAIN for a bath.
completion: The party leaves the room or the Lamb loses track of them.

fields.title: Little Lambs Emerge from the Corpse
fields.perceived: After a quiet delay, three Little Lambs chew their way out of the Lamb’s corpse.

activation.condition: The Lamb is killed and its corpse is not utterly destroyed.

participants.role: New predators emerging from the corpse.

stakes: Three new hostile creatures enter the dungeon.
outcomes: Three Little Lambs become active after waiting quietly inside the corpse.
completion: All three Little Lambs have emerged, or the corpse is utterly destroyed before they emerge.

fields.title: Father Bastoval Enters the Dungeon
fields.perceived: Father Bastoval enters with two elderly bodyguards to check on the Lamb.

activation.condition: Two hours after the Lamb is killed.

stakes: If the Lamb is dead, Bastoval hunts its killers.
outcomes: Bastoval and his bodyguards check on the Lamb.
If the Lamb is dead, they hunt the Lamb’s murderers.

fields.title: The Skull of Davok Escapes
fields.perceived: When the lead-and-iron chest is opened, the Skull of Davok escapes.

activation.condition: Open the lead-and-iron chest in 4 CHESTS after removing both linchpins.

stakes: A contained supernatural skull is released.
outcomes: The Skull of Davok escapes the chest.

fields.title: Tumbler Password Check
fields.perceived: Pulling the lever makes the mechanism evaluate the four numbered disks.

activation.condition: Set the four tumblers and pull the lever in 6 TUMBLERS.

repeat.condition: The acid sprays only once; the grinding noise occurs on every incorrect attempt.

stakes: An incorrect code triggers noise and acid.
The correct code opens access to 7 THRONE.
outcomes: Correct setting: the door to 7 THRONE opens.
Incorrect setting: a horrible grinding noise occurs every time and milky acid sprays once, dealing 1d6 diminishing damage each turn until rinsed off.

fields.title: Sitting on the Throne
fields.perceived: The seated character undergoes a bodily transformation and receives a vision of a purple book wrapped in fine copper chains.

activation.condition: A character sits on the throne in 7 THRONE.

repeat.condition: The throne works only once per year.

stakes: The character risks permanent obesity and a weaker claw, but may gain a stronger claw.
approaches: Sit on the throne and make a Charisma Save.
outcomes: Success: the right hand becomes a large lobster claw dealing 1d8.
Failure: gain 3 Inventory Slots of fat and the right hand becomes a small lobster claw dealing 1d6.
Regardless of result, receive a vision of a purple book wrapped in fine copper chains.
Anyone with a lobster claw is Favored by Vandoh.
Sitting on the throne counts as a Milestone.
completion: Resolve the Charisma Save and all resulting changes.

fields.title: Akina’s Rescue Bargain
fields.perceived: Akina, a ragged captive in the pit, offers a valuable ruby ring in exchange for rescue.

activation.condition: The party communicates with Akina in 8 PIT.

repeat.condition: Until Akina is rescued or the offer is otherwise resolved.

stakes: Akina’s freedom.
The Ruby Ring of Wisdom worth 1000s.
Access to basic information about the White Temple, Vandoh, and the Lamb.
approaches: Ask Akina about the White Temple, Vandoh, or the Lamb.
outcomes: Akina offers the Ruby Ring of Wisdom in exchange for rescue.
Akina can provide basic information about the White Temple, Vandoh, and the Lamb.

fields.title: The Haunting of 9 FOUNTAIN
fields.perceived: The first entrant collapses, gasps, and flops for 1 round while hallucinating that heavy armor is holding them underwater. The first person to touch the water is then shoved in without a save as a man’s death-gasps fill the air.

activation.condition: The first person enters 9 FOUNTAIN; separately, the first person touches its water.

stakes: A victim can be supernaturally held underwater.
Destroying the skeleton can permanently curse the destroyer with fear of water.
approaches: Remove the armored skeleton and pray over it.
outcomes: The first entrant hallucinates drowning for 1 round.
The first person to touch the water is shoved in with no save and cannot get any part of their body out of the water; others experience normal water.
Removing the skeleton and sincerely praying over it ends the haunting.
Destroying the skeleton ends the haunting, but the destroyer must make a Charisma Save or become permanently afraid of water.
completion: The armored skeleton is removed and sincerely prayed over, or destroyed.

fields.title: The Lamb Blocks the Bone-Pile Tunnel
fields.perceived: Bones begin filling the small crawl tunnel between 10 BONE PILE and 14 SARCOPHAGUS.

activation.condition: After 3 encounters with the Lamb.

participants.role: Blocks the tunnel after becoming cunning.

stakes: The dungeon loop can be obstructed.
outcomes: The Lamb begins blocking the crawl tunnel with bones.
A blocked tunnel takes 10 minutes to clear by hand.

fields.title: Collapse of 12 ABACUS MURAL
fields.perceived: The sagging ceiling falls when its supporting pike is removed.

activation.condition: Remove the 10-foot wooden pike supporting the roof.

stakes: A character can die while removing the pike.
The room becomes impassable.
The Lamb can be injured and temporarily trapped.
outcomes: Grabbing the pike and running requires a Movement check to avoid dying.
The room becomes impassable.
If the Lamb is beneath the collapse, it takes 3d6 damage, digs out in 30 minutes toward the north side, and is helpless for 1 round while emerging.

fields.title: Sarcophagus Trapdoor
fields.perceived: Mechanical sounds come from beneath the sarcophagus; with the lid replaced, its bottom swings open and drops the occupant 10 feet into 14A SHADRAKUL.

activation.condition: A person enters the sarcophagus and the lid is replaced.

stakes: The occupant falls 10 feet.
Ropes crossing the bladed lid are severed.
outcomes: The bottom swings open and dumps the occupant into 14A SHADRAKUL.
The bladed lid edges sever ropes.
Removing the lid again swings the bottom shut.

fields.title: Goblet and Skeletal Serpent Trap
fields.perceived: The delicate goblet begins to topple at the slightest touch, and a skeletal serpent lunges from the robed skeleton when anyone approaches.

activation.condition: Touch the goblet or approach the robed skeleton in 14A SHADRAKUL.

participants.role: Holds the spellbook and precarious goblet.

stakes: The crystal goblet worth 800s can break.
The serpent’s bite requires a save or causes death.
approaches: Try to secure the goblet without touching or jostling it.
Approach the skeleton to take the spellbook.
outcomes: The slightest touch makes the goblet fall and break.
Approaching the skeleton triggers a skeletal serpent attack.

fields.title: Red Spider Exposure
fields.perceived: Hundreds of tiny red spiders crawl through the cramped passage.

activation.condition: For every minute spent exposed in 15 CRACK.

stakes: A bite can cause temporary wheezing and muteness; a second bite is instantly fatal.
outcomes: Each minute has a 50% chance of a bite.
A first bite causes wheezing and muteness for 1 hour.
A second bite causes instant death with no Save.

fields.title: Danjo’s Extortion and Trade
fields.perceived: The chicken vendor outside the crack demands a reason not to report the party to the temple guards, then offers goods at extreme prices.

activation.condition: The party talks to Danjo through the opening in 15 CRACK.

stakes: Danjo may alert the temple guards.
Mundane goods cost at least 20 times market value.
Special purchases take 1-3 hours.
approaches: Give Danjo a reason or payment not to inform the guards.
Buy candles, chickens, bread, or a knife.
Ask him to purchase another item across town.
outcomes: Once the extortion is resolved, Danjo sells mundane items at no less than 20 times market value.
He can fetch other items in 1-3 hours.
Conversation time is real time: 1 in-game minute equals 1 minute at the table.

fields.title: Yellow Mold Chest
fields.perceived: Opening the sagging, yellow-rotted chest carelessly releases yellow mold exposure.

activation.condition: Open the wooden chest in 17 ALTAR carelessly.

stakes: The opener may take poison damage.
outcomes: Careless opening exposes the opener to yellow mold poison for 1d6 damage.
The chest contains rotten worthless books and a 50s silver-plate dageurrotype.

fields.title: Looting the Armored Corpse
fields.perceived: An armored corpse lies 10 feet beyond a sealed portcullis, close enough to pull toward the bars but too large to pass through.

activation.condition: Attempt to retrieve the corpse or its equipment through the portcullis at 18A LEDGE.

stakes: The party can recover valuable equipment, but the breastplate and helmet cannot fit through the bars.
approaches: Pull the corpse to the portcullis and remove items that fit.
outcomes: The sword, bow and arrows, signet ring, and Orb of Indulgence can be looted.
The masterwork breastplate and helmet are too large to pass through the portcullis.

fields.title: Starting the Game
steps: State that the room is pitch black.
Apply dehydration to everyone: -4 to all rolls until they drink water; without water they die in 24 hours.
Begin everyone naked and possessing nothing, except one person has a knife.
Without a sack or backpack, limit each person to carrying two items.
Give each player control of 1 free character; their other characters remain restrained.
Have the Lamb lumber into the room.
Resolve hiding, noisy flight, or quiet departure as described by the opening situation.

fields.title: Opening the Iron-Banded Chest at 5 LANDING
fields.trigger: The party attempts to open the locked iron-banded chest without an obvious key or normal method.
steps: Use a sufficiently destructive method, such as dropping a sarcophagus lid on it, throwing it down 8 PIT, or getting the Lamb to trample it.
Open the broken chest.
The force used breaks the vial of lamp oil inside; the fresh torch remains.

fields.title: Operating the Tumbler Password System
fields.trigger: A character sets the four rotating disks and pulls the lever in 6 TUMBLERS.
steps: Set each disk to a number from 1 to 8.
Pull the lever.
If the setting is 1-2-1-2, open the door to 7 THRONE.
If the setting is incorrect, produce a horrible grinding noise every time and spray milky acid once; the acid deals 1d6 diminishing damage each turn until rinsed off.

fields.title: Ending the Fountain Haunting
fields.trigger: The party attempts to end the haunting in 9 FOUNTAIN.
steps: Locate the armored skeleton in the shallows by investigating the pool.
Either remove it from the water and pray over it sincerely, or destroy it.
If it is removed and prayed over, even the shortest sincere prayer ends the haunting.
If it is destroyed, the haunting ends, then the destroyer makes a Charisma Save; on a failure, the destroyer becomes permanently afraid of water.

fields.title: Searching 10 BONE PILE
fields.trigger: A character spends time searching the bone-pellet pile.
steps: For every man-hour spent searching, roll 1d20.
Consult the Bone Pile Search table for the result.
Any amount of searching also reveals the small crawl tunnel to 14 SARCOPHAGUS.

fields.title: Clearing the Blocked Bone-Pile Tunnel
fields.trigger: The Lamb has blocked the crawl tunnel between 10 BONE PILE and 14 SARCOPHAGUS with bones.
steps: Clear the blockage by hand for 10 minutes.
Reopen the crawl tunnel.

fields.title: Collapsing 12 ABACUS MURAL
fields.trigger: A character removes the 10-foot wooden pike supporting the sagging roof.
steps: Grab the pike and run.
Make a Movement check to avoid dying in the collapse.
Make the room impassable after the ceiling falls.
If the Lamb is under the collapse, deal 3d6 damage; it digs out in 30 minutes, probably on the north side, and is helpless for 1 round as it exits.

fields.title: Using the Sarcophagus Trapdoor
fields.trigger: A person enters the sarcophagus in 14 SARCOPHAGUS.
steps: Replace the bladed lid.
The bottom swings open and drops the occupant 10 feet onto the rugs in 14A SHADRAKUL; ropes crossing the lid are severed.
Remove the lid again to swing the bottom shut.
If the black iron spellbook is held, the trapdoor locks open.

fields.title: Trading with Danjo
fields.trigger: The party opens a conversation with Danjo through 15 CRACK.
steps: Resolve Danjo’s threat to inform the temple guards by giving him a reason not to.
Afterward, buy available mundane goods—candles, chickens, bread, and a knife—at the highest price he can demand, never below 20 times market value.
For other goods, ask Danjo to run across town; delivery takes 1-3 hours depending on the item.
Conduct the conversation in real time: 1 in-game minute equals 1 minute at the table.

fields.title: Looting the Corpse Beyond the Portcullis
fields.trigger: The party reaches 18A LEDGE and tries to recover the armored corpse’s equipment.
steps: Pull the corpse to the sealed portcullis.
Remove items that fit through the bars: sword, bow and arrows, signet ring, and Orb of Indulgence.
Leave the masterwork breastplate and helmet behind because they are too large to pass through the portcullis.

fields.title: Expected Dungeon Flow
fields.text: The expected but not required sequence is: flee or hide, then return to free captives; lure the Lamb away from 9 FOUNTAIN and drink; follow the main path to 13 CITY MURAL, where the bashed-in door reinforces that locked doors can be broken; and escape through 21 HEAVY DOOR. Equipment such as light, rope, and weapons gates progress. The dungeon has one valuable but imperfect loop through a secret tunnel that the Lamb can eventually block. Deaths are expected, and the Lamb stopping to eat helps prevent a total party kill.

fields.title: Tumbler Password
fields.text: The four-digit password for 6 TUMBLERS is 1-2-1-2. The same pattern is signaled by the regular drips at 9 FOUNTAIN.

fields.title: Akina’s Knowledge
fields.text: Akina can tell the party the basics about the White Temple, Vandoh, and the Lamb; the source does not provide those explanations on this page.

uncertainties.description: The page states only that Akina knows the basics; it does not print the specific information she would reveal.

fields.title: Climbable Walls and Darkness
fields.text: The rough-hewn stone walls are climbable, and the dungeon is pitch black.

fields.title: Starting Dehydration
fields.text: Everyone begins dehydrated and takes -4 to all rolls until drinking water. Without water, everyone is dead in 24 hours.

fields.title: Starting Gear and Carrying Capacity
fields.text: Everyone begins naked and possessing nothing, except one person has a knife. Without a sack or backpack, each person can hold only two items.

fields.title: Starting Character Control
fields.text: Each player controls 1 free character; that player’s other characters remain restrained.

fields.title: Finding the Door in Darkness
fields.text: If the PCs flee noisily from the opening room, finding the door in the dark requires a Wisdom check.

fields.title: Track Torch Durations
fields.text: Torch durations must be followed; light is a precious constraint and should not be bypassed.

fields.title: Improvised Weapons
fields.text: Improvised weapons are poor-quality (“shitty”) and should not let the party bypass the scenario’s weapon scarcity.

fields.title: Improvised Ropes
fields.text: Improvised ropes have a 4-in-6 failure chance. Tell the players that chance before they use the rope.

fields.title: Earth Tremor on the Lamb’s Death
fields.text: When the Lamb is killed, the earth trembles as Vandoh mourns his child.

fields.title: Lamb-Kill Milestone
fields.text: Killing the Lamb counts as a Milestone.

fields.title: Little Lamb Emergence
fields.text: If the Lamb is killed but its corpse is not utterly destroyed, three Little Lambs wait quietly and then chew their way out.

fields.title: Bastoval’s Nemesis Advancement
fields.text: Each time Father Bastoval kills a PC, he gains a level, and the GM thereafter introduces him as “Bastoval, Slayer of X”.

fields.title: Milky Acid Spray
fields.text: On an incorrect tumbler entry, milky acid sprays once and deals 1d6 diminishing damage each turn until rinsed off.

fields.title: Throne Transformation
fields.text: A successful Charisma Save turns the right hand into a large lobster claw dealing 1d8. A failed save adds 3 Inventory Slots of fat and turns the right hand into a small lobster claw dealing 1d6.

fields.title: Vision of the Chained Purple Book
fields.text: Regardless of the throne save result, the sitter sees a vision of a purple book wrapped in fine copper chains.

fields.title: Favored by Vandoh
fields.text: Anyone with a lobster claw is Favored by Vandoh.

fields.title: Throne Milestone
fields.text: Sitting on the throne counts as a Milestone.

fields.title: Drowning Hallucination
fields.text: The first person to enter 9 FOUNTAIN falls, gasps, and flops for 1 round while hallucinating that heavy armor traps them underwater.

fields.title: Haunted Water Binding
fields.text: The first person to touch the fountain water is shoved in with no save. The water weighs that person down so no part of the body can exit, while a man’s death-gasps fill the air. The water behaves normally for everyone else.

fields.title: Permanent Fear of Water
fields.text: If the armored skeleton is destroyed to end the haunting, the destroyer must make a Charisma Save; on a failure, the destroyer becomes permanently afraid of water.

fields.title: Collapsed Abacus-Mural Room
fields.text: Removing the supporting pike collapses the ceiling. Grabbing the pike and running requires a Movement check to avoid dying, and the room becomes impassable.

fields.title: Lamb Trapped by Collapse
fields.text: If the ceiling collapses on the Lamb, it takes 3d6 damage, digs out in 30 minutes—probably on the north side—and is helpless for 1 round as it exits. Digging can be heard by anyone investigating the rubble.

fields.title: Bladed Sarcophagus Rope-Cut
fields.text: The sarcophagus lid edges are sharp enough to cut ropes and sever ropes when the trapdoor dumps an occupant.

fields.title: Skeletal Serpent Bite
fields.text: The skeletal serpent’s bite requires a save or causes death.

fields.title: Red Spider Bites
fields.text: Each minute in 15 CRACK has a 50% chance of a bite. A first bite causes wheezing and muteness for 1 hour; a second bite causes instant death with no Save.

fields.title: Yellow Mold Poison
fields.text: Carelessly opening the chest in 17 ALTAR exposes the opener to yellow mold poison for 1d6 damage.

fields.title: delay
fields.text: Father Bastoval has the spell delay; no spell mechanics are printed on this page.

uncertainties.description: Only the spell name is listed; its rules text is not provided in this evidence pack.

fields.title: haste
fields.text: Father Bastoval has the spell haste; no spell mechanics are printed on this page.

uncertainties.description: Only the spell name is listed; its rules text is not provided in this evidence pack.

fields.title: scry
fields.text: Father Bastoval has the spell scry; no spell mechanics are printed on this page.

uncertainties.description: Only the spell name is listed; its rules text is not provided in this evidence pack.

entries.result: The Lamb approaches, full of bile and loathing.

The Lamb is in an adjacent room, doing something disgusting and noisy: regurgitating a bone pellet, banging its head against the wall in a fit of self-loathing, or dragging its genitals across the ground.
The Three Little Lambs, crawling on the ceiling. They drop down to run faster.
Bastoval (Clr 3) leads Mino and Bilosh (Ftr 1, Ftr 1) to check on the Lamb.
The Three Little Lambs, digging loudly inside a nearby wall.
A ghostly image of Bastoval appears. “So that’s where you are,” he says. He will arrive in 1d6 rounds.
Echoes of the Lamb’s voice, far away, still crying out “Father! Father!”
Silver bracelet shaped like veins, worth 100s.

uncertainties.description: The printed d20 table has no entry for a roll of 13.

fields.title: Short Lengths of Twine
fields.text: Short lengths of twine tie the goats in 2 GOATS.

fields.title: Goat Bells
fields.text: All four goats in 2 GOATS wear bells.

fields.title: Pile of Hay
fields.text: A pile of hay lies in 2 GOATS.

fields.title: Empty Wooden Bowl
fields.text: An empty wooden bowl is in 2 GOATS.

fields.title: Empty Wine Bottle
fields.text: An empty wine bottle is found by investigating the vinegar trough in 3 VINEGAR.

fields.title: Immature Lambfruit
fields.text: One immature Lambfruit rests on the wooden table in 4 CHESTS; see Appendix D.

fields.title: Masterwork Helmet
fields.text: A masterwork helmet with a smiling face and squinting eyes is inside the wooden chest in 4 CHESTS.

fields.title: Torch from 4 CHESTS
fields.text: One torch is inside the wooden chest in 4 CHESTS.

fields.title: Purple Lotus Powder
fields.text: A purple pouch in 4 CHESTS contains 2 doses of purple lotus powder; see Appendix D.

fields.title: Lotus Pipe
fields.text: A lotus pipe in 4 CHESTS fits into the masterwork helmet and is worth 100s.

fields.title: Skull of Davok
fields.text: The lead-and-iron chest in 4 CHESTS contains only the Skull of Davok, which escapes when the chest is opened; see Appendix A.

fields.title: Lit Torch at 5 LANDING
fields.text: A lit torch atop a metal pole can be picked up easily and will burn for another hour.

fields.title: 6-Foot Iron Torch-Holder Pole
fields.text: The metal torch holder at 5 LANDING is a 6-foot iron pole that can be pried out with difficulty.

fields.title: Fire Striker
fields.text: A fire striker rests atop the locked chest at 5 LANDING.

fields.title: Fresh Torch
fields.text: A fresh torch is inside the locked iron-banded chest at 5 LANDING.

fields.title: Vial of Lamp Oil
fields.text: A vial of lamp oil is inside the locked chest at 5 LANDING; the listed destructive opening methods break it.

fields.title: Broom
fields.text: A broom is in 5A CLOSET.

fields.title: Gong and Hammer
fields.text: A gong and hammer are in 5A CLOSET.

fields.title: Golden Sensory Deprivation Helmet
fields.text: A golden sensory-deprivation helmet worth 700s is in 7 THRONE.

fields.title: Ruby Ring of Wisdom
fields.text: Akina carries the Ruby Ring of Wisdom, worth 1000s, and offers it in exchange for rescue.

fields.title: Bone Pellets
fields.text: 10 BONE PILE contains 255 pellets, each holding about 100 pounds of compressed bone fragments only slightly smoothed by digestion.

fields.title: Battered Shield
fields.text: A roll of 14 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a battered shield.

fields.title: Spear
fields.text: A roll of 15 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a spear.

fields.title: 30-Foot Rope from the Bone Pile
fields.text: A roll of 16 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a 30-foot rope.

fields.title: Torch from the Bone Pile
fields.text: A roll of 17 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a torch.

fields.title: Bottle of Liquid Hole
fields.text: A roll of 18 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a bottle of liquid hole; see Appendix A.

fields.title: Silver Bracelet Shaped Like Veins
fields.text: A roll of 19 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a silver bracelet shaped like veins, worth 100s.

fields.title: Bottle of Fine Wine
fields.text: A roll of 20 on the Bone Pile Search table yields a bottle of fine wine worth 30s.

fields.title: Unused Torch at 14 SARCOPHAGUS
fields.text: An unused torch hangs on the wall in 14 SARCOPHAGUS.

fields.title: 10-Foot Wooden Pike
fields.text: A 10-foot wooden pike supports the sagging roof in 12 ABACUS MURAL; removing it collapses the ceiling.

fields.title: Eight Soft Rugs
fields.text: Eight soft rugs cushion the 10-foot fall into 14A SHADRAKUL and are worth 400s.

fields.title: Black Iron Spellbook
fields.text: The robed skeleton in 14A SHADRAKUL offers a black iron spellbook; once it is held, the sarcophagus trapdoor locks open. See Appendix A.

fields.title: Delicate Crystal Goblet
fields.text: A delicate crystal goblet worth 800s is balanced on the skeleton’s knee; the slightest touch makes it tumble and break.

fields.title: Danjo’s Candles
fields.text: Danjo currently sells candles, never for less than 20 times market value.

fields.title: Danjo’s Chickens
fields.text: Danjo currently sells chickens, never for less than 20 times market value.

fields.title: Danjo’s Bread
fields.text: Danjo currently sells bread, never for less than 20 times market value.

fields.title: Danjo’s Knife
fields.text: Danjo currently sells a knife, never for less than 20 times market value.

fields.title: Silver-Plate Dageurrotype
fields.text: A silver-plate dageurrotype worth 50s shows a dozen strangely dressed men buried to their waists, facing the stars with mouths open.

fields.title: White Candle
fields.text: A hidden drawer in the altar at 17 ALTAR contains one white candle.

fields.title: Block and Tackle
fields.text: Searching the fallen-elevator wreckage in 18 SHAFT reveals a block and tackle.

fields.title: 30-Foot Rope at 18A LEDGE
fields.text: A 30-foot rope lies on 18A LEDGE.

fields.title: Iron Spike
fields.text: An iron spike lies on 18A LEDGE.

fields.title: Sword with Conidiopore Insignia
fields.text: The armored corpse beyond the portcullis carries a sword bearing a conidiopore insignia.

uncertainties.description: The source spells the sword insignia “conidiopore,” while the signet-ring insignia is printed “conidiospore.”

fields.title: Bow and Arrows
fields.text: The armored corpse beyond the portcullis carries a bow and arrows.

fields.title: Signet Ring with Conidiospore Insignia
fields.text: The armored corpse beyond the portcullis carries a signet ring worth 50s with a conidiospore insignia.

uncertainties.description: The source spells the signet-ring insignia “conidiospore,” while the sword insignia is printed “conidiopore.”

fields.text: The armored corpse beyond the portcullis carries an Orb of Indulgence worth 500s.

fields.title: Masterwork Breastplate

fields.title: Helmet Beyond the Portcullis
fields.text: The armored corpse has a helmet that is too large to pass through the portcullis.

fields.title: Plaza Beside the White Temple
fields.first_impression: A plaza beside the White Temple lies beyond the fist-sized opening at the end of 15 CRACK; a chicken vendor sits there and can be seen through the opening.
contents: A fist-sized opening overlooking the plaza from 15 CRACK.
